messages:
Elliot (AE): Heads-up 1: AstraCorp CFO paused POC signoff. Three non-negotiables: 1) BYO KMS (no export), 2) Okta SSO + SCIM provisioning, 3) pilot latency commitment (p95). Need quick triage and exec bridge tomorrow morning.
Sara (SE): Ack. Do they require on-prem HSM with live peering or cloud-KMS BYOK import?
Elliot (AE): They said HSM-only; keys must remain in their appliance.
Vik (Presales): Reality: we don't offer direct HSM RPC peering as standard. Two paths: A) KMS-proxy routing signing to their HSM over mTLS (short-term), B) cloud-KMS with strict import and attestation. Both need security/legal review.
Luis (SRE): Perf input: target 500 qps, seq=64. Internal baseline for rw-v2-large seq64: p50~50ms, p95~130ms. With 500 qps and HSM latency in-path, expect p95 to move up ~20-40ms. Dedicated reserved capacity + aggressive batching recommended.
Anya (Security): Security asks: HSM vendor FIPS/SOC cert, network diagram, mutual TLS cert exchange, attestation form, and a threat summary. Live peering raises additional controls.
Nina (Legal): Legal: we can prepare a KMS addendum and a timeboxed pilot SLA (credits capped), but HSM peering will require a crypto addendum and liability carve-outs. Send any procurement redlines.
Vik (Presales): Proposed short timeline to present on the bridge: Day 0-2: contracts + KMS addendum; Day 3-4: cert exchange + MTLS test; Day 5-7: perf runs + tuning; Day 8: exec signoff.
Elliot (AE): They want an exec bridge at 8:30am PT tomorrow. Can we confirm attendance?
Luis (SRE): 8:30am PT I can join. I'll run a quick staging smoke with a mocked HSM today and post numbers. Command: `./smoke --model rw-v2-large --concurrency 500 --seq 64 --kv-cache`
Sara (SE): I'll prepare two diagrams (HSM peering vs KMS-proxy) and a one-pager Okta/SCIM checklist.
Anya (Security): I'll pull the attestation template and request their SOC contact and vendor certs.
Nina (Legal): I'll draft a pilot SLA and short crypto addendum; will review procurement redlines.
Vik (Presales): I'll make a 3-slide deck: options, timeline, risk + fallback (cached responses or fallback model).
notify-bot: Ticket created SLS-26001: "AstraCorp POC - HSM peering + Okta + pilot SLA" assigned to eng-oncall. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SLS-26001
Elliot (AE): Owners: Luis -> perf smoke + ops checklist; Sara -> diagrams + SSO runbook; Vik -> bridge deck + timeline; Anya -> attestation + risk note; Nina -> addendum + SLA. I'll schedule the bridge and send invite to customer.
Sara (SE): Note for slides: recommend `--kv-cache-enabled` and `--batch-policy=aggressive` as tuning knobs.
Elliot (AE): Thanks team. Customer priority is key control; keep the HSM path explicit and show the KMS-proxy fallback.
